sample_posts.text:
Ouroboros Capital Says a Regime Shift Is Underway
> Government trying to control rising long-term interest rates through Treasury buybacks, gold and Bitcoin are rallying as a result, while AI stocks are quietly showing weakness, raising questions about whether the sector is rolling over from its peak.
Source:
https://x.com/OuroborosCap8/status/2090222119066169590

tweet.text:
Today's move once again strengthened my view that we are in the midst of a regime shift. It is quite clear that we are already on the train with the destination not being so clear. 

A couple of observations and thoughts from my end:
- Buying of long end Treasuries by the govt signals that they are indeed uncomfortable with where rates are at (e.g. 5.3% 30Y). So they are paying attention but the announced amounts (~$4bn) is really a nothing burger. The big question is "can they really cap the rising 30Y" and "what would happen if they can". Its a question of the determination and consequence b

sample_posts.text:
30-year Treasury yield hits 5.33%, highest since 2007, pressuring risk assets –
Link
Long-term U.S. bond yields keep climbing on fiscal deficit and inflation concerns, with the 30-year yield now at its highest level in nearly two decades. Higher real yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets like Bitcoin.
Matters because: If the yield uptrend holds, it can weigh on crypto valuations even if broader market risk appetite stays intact.
